signalPolicy: Five independent technical signals; union, no score or ranking. Freeze before first fixture evaluation. No condition additions in response to misses.

unused.duration: Descriptive only; no short-caption or fixed-second threshold.
unused.gap: Descriptive only; no empirically justified naturalness threshold.
unused.exactTimestampDisagreement: Not alone a review flag: token observations and perceptual timing are not identical.
unused.zeroVideoFrameRecognition: Not used: positive sub-frame character times do not alone imply cue failure.
